description: Ministry of Sports - The Anti-Doping (Prohibited List) Regulations No. 02 of 2015 that is came into operation on 01.01.2016
reasoning: This gazette contains regulations made by the Minister of Sports under the Convention against Doping in Sport Act, No. 33 of 2013. It establishes the prohibited list of substances and methods in sports, which constitutes regulatory framework and compliance requirements falling under Legal/Regulatory matters. While it mentions a minister's name, it does not involve government personnel changes or structural reorganization, but rather creates binding legal regulations.
